crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will…
As you enter into the household, greet it.
If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of…
He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

parallels.note: As you enter into the household, greet it.

translations.web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
translations.bsb: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
translations.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
translations.asv: And into whatsoever house ye shall enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
